description: This file defines mixins for hiding text in CSS, with a deprecated function `.hide-text()` and a newer `.text-hide()` that calls the former.

methods.name: .hide-text()
methods.description: A mixin that sets styles to hide text visually and accessibly.

methods.name: .text-hide()
methods.description: A mixin that calls `.hide-text()` for consistent hiding behavior.
